articles.headline: Valkyries top Wings to clinch playoff spot for 2nd straight season
articles.description: The Valkyries beat the Wings 78-70 to clinch a playoff spot Monday night, becoming only the fourth franchise to make the playoffs in each of its first two seasons.

images.name: Natalie Nakase [600x400]
images.caption: "The goal is to be the team that wins the last game of the season," Valkyries coach Natalie Nakase said. "With that, this is just the art of the process that we have to build to be in the playoffs. But we have so much work to do."

articles.headline: Valkyries are playoff bound again in 2nd year after beating Dallas 78-70 behind Williams' 23 points
articles.description: — Gabby Williams had 23 points and seven rebounds, Veronica Burton added 16 points and five assists, and the Golden State Valkyries clinched a playoff berth by beating the Dallas Wings 78-70 on Monday night for their sixth straight victory.

articles.headline: The secrets behind Angel Reese's legendary rebounding
articles.description: Angel Reese isn't the tallest player in the league, and she isn't its best leaper. So how is it that she's grabbing rebounds at a pace never before seen in the WNBA?

images.name: Angel Reese [1296x729]
images.caption: In just her third season in the WNBA, Angel Reese already has three of the 10 best rebounding seasons in league history.

images.name: Angel Reese [800x533]
images.caption: Reese set Atlanta's single-season rebounding record on Thursday night in Connecticut. She has 384 and counting in 2026.

images.name: Angel Reese [1296x1296]
images.caption: Reese gives up a couple inches to Dominique Malonga, but she will rarely give up on a chance to secure a rebound.

images.name: Angel Reese [800x450]
images.caption: Reese is entirely, completely and totally unapologetic for racking up the "mebounds."

images.name: Angel Reese [800x533]
images.caption: Reese and Kamilla Cardoso have been battling for boards -- sometimes against each other and sometimes for each other -- since high school.
